reviews.text: I love bringing my cat to Companion Animal Hospital Oak Park. They always treat Murphy with love and care. I have been bringing him there since 2019. He came in today for a wellness exam.
Wellness exam! Doctor was great with my pitty

My cat's initial appointment didn't go well as he was too upset to be seen. $75 charge for nothing. We then arranged for a drop off appointment for my cat. I scheduled it for Monday morning and when I arrived they told me this wasn't a scheduled dropoff appointment. This experience was not up to par.
The team at Companion in Oak Park are extremely friendly approachable and treated my dog with the most care. I highly recommend the team.
Have been taking my little guy here since he was a pup. Great place, and very professional team here

Reception was great! Assistant was amazing! The doctor really hears you out and  explains things with so much clarity and patience.
Pricing is fair and manageable.
Excellent service as well as very attentive staff.

Very disappointed with my experience at this location. I brought my dog in for a simple nail trim. This was only our second time visiting this location, as we normally go somewhere else, but I chose this one because it is closer to home.

We arrived on time for our appointment, only to be told that we would be charged almost double the regular price because my dog gets extremely nervous during nail trims and they would need two technicians to assist her.

I was honestly confused and frustrated. This is a veterinary hospital, so I would expect the staff to be experienced in handling nervous or anxious pets. I have never been told before that I would be charged nearly double simply because two staff members were needed for a nail trim.

What disappointed me the most was the lack of communication. If there was going to be an additional charge due to my dog’s anxiety or because she required two technicians, I wish this had been communicated before the appointment. It would have saved me the time and inconvenience of driving there.

Unfortunately, this experience left me very disappointed with this location and how the situation was handled. Clear communication about pricing and additional fees should happen before a customer arrives for their appointment
Only place that would groom my angry old man cat. They do a good job and they seem to like him despite his surly personality. The grooming price keeps going up every time.
Very caring and gentle eats and staff. Accommodating and understanding.
Very welcoming and was very good with my dog
Good sevice, nice staff
Very kind friend and patient towards my very fearful dog.
Wonderful place and vets

I brought my dog in for an abscess he had under his eye which the Dr has been very kind in handling him when checking out his eye, teeth, and ears. Dogs are expensive but I’m glad I’ve had really good and polite service here.

Dr Cheryle and vet tech Jacqueline are amazing.  We followed Dr Cheryle from her last vet office.  You will not find better care than with her.
Ever since she has no longer been the medical director the place has been AWFUL.  Front office staff are the worst.  They nickel and dime you foe everything.  When you show up they tell you that your appointment is at a different time (had the written time with me and still)
The MANAGER is literally the most awful person around. Yells and is very condescending.
If you go there then prepare yourself and make sure you ONLY see Dr Cheryle and Jacqueline
I was able to get an appointment the same day.
Really great and attentive staff and they’re really nice to our pets, always have treats for them ready!
Was able to get a same day appoint.  Staff was very friendly and courteous as always.
Excellent service and very nice staff!
My first time at this clinic and I really liked it. I got an appointment the same day and everyone was very friendly; the information they gave me was very clear.
Doctor Cheryl and the assistant were great for Pickle’s first puppy visit. Super attentive and answered all my questions. They made pickle so comfortable! Will be back.
Knowledgeable and kind.
Took great care of my pup for his vaccinations! Very gentle and kind staff.
Able to book a same day appointment for my dog, everyone was very sweet and knowledgeable. Would recommend!
The vets are all very good and patient with the dogs. They keep them calm and do the necessary work without causing any unnecessary stress.

My fur baby Alika is always warmly welcomed here at Companion Animal Hospital. She has no issues with the staff, and they're very friendly with her. The pricing is a bit high, but they do try their best to accommodate. I've been going to this vet since my dog was a puppy, and I always return.
They were all so nice I will go there again for sure.
This vet is pretty clean and nice when they meet my dog they always provide good care.
Appreciate the follow up and reminder calls.  Always a good experience with staff, especially Alexia.

We are incredibly grateful for the care we received. The doctor was kind, professional, and made us feel supported during a very stressful time. The entire staff was warm, positive, and welcoming from the moment we arrived. Everyone treated us with compassion and patience, and we truly appreciated how comfortable and cared for they made our family feel. Thank you for the excellent care and kindness.

Melissa Carbajal, the vet, and tech Evany were absolutely wonderful at Companion Animal Hospital Oak Park! They took such great care of my Pomeranian and made the whole experience stress-free. Everyone was so kind, gentle, and compassionate, and you can truly tell they love what they do. I’m very grateful for the amazing care my pup received and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy animal hospital!
As always detailed and great service.

The staff here is truly the best. I brought my dog in for an ear infection and we were able to get seen right away. The receptionists were friendly, welcoming, and very accommodating, which helped my dog feel comfortable from the moment we walked in.
Dr. Cheryl is amazing—attentive, compassionate, and genuinely caring when it comes to our fur babies.
I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a veterinary team that treats your pets with real kindness and professionalism.
Amazing vet! Love going to them! Kind, timely, knowledgeable!
Was happy they were able to see our dog same day. Friendly staff.
Great care
Entire staff is very friendly and helpful! Willing to answer all your questions and concerns. Having an injured pet is stressful, but they made the process smooth as it could be.
Able to get my sick kitty it same day!!
Super friendly and love bringing my pets here.
Everything went very smoothly. We got a new puppy and had a wellness check, vaccines, and microchipping. Everyone was very friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable.
Very helpful and caring clinic! they are awesome with pets
they are always very kind and thorough. they work to help my cats anxiety from being at the vet with treats and pets and other distraction.
I go for my cats routine veterinary care and they always do a great job and provide wonderful care!
Jackie and the team were amazing! They were so helpful with my dog’s checkup and vaccines

Always treat my babies with loving 💅😘
Always call to make sure my babies are going ❤️‍🩹
Stsrtef coming here after covid and wish I had started coming earlier. Very personable and professional. They take their time to discuss and answer questions
Excellent caring vet
Companion animal hospital  has great staff.  Professional and caring.  As with all vets pricey but when your pet needs care you want them to have the best
The staff were very nice and caring, did not rush me and answered all my questions.
Dr Cheryle is the best. Kind, knowledge and really cares about the dogs
Our dogs have been recurring patients for the last several years. Very kind and thorough! Highly recommend!
Always appreciate the kind, empathetic and caring service we get for our pups!
Always friendly and thoughtful. They always follow-up after visits or procedure. My Big Guy has never gone elsewhere. His groomer Laurie is like family.
Been coming here for years.  The staff is so attentive ang friendly.  Wouldn't take my dogs anywhere else.
I love Companion Animal Hospital, everyone is so nice and friendly.
Always a pleasure. Dr. Cheryl along with staff are always professional and attentive to my little ones needs. Highly recommended.
Always a great visit!  Very professional staff!
Dr Cheryl is the best, and the rest are also awesome. Come from out of our way for our fur babies. All the stars for these stars
I brought my baby doggie turbo in for his annual exam and health shots. The staff in the place is extremely well friendly and very knowledgeable
Been coming for years and staff is always so kind, helpful, and thoroughly explains all treatment plans

Ariel and Dr. Melissa took great care of my cat Jasper, who was extremely anxious to get taken care of. They treated him with respect and patience instead of an inconvenience for some of the challenging behavior.
Amazing vets that listen to your concerns!

First time at this hospital with my cat Coco. Came to see Dr. Cheryl. She is a very caring, considerate, humble doctor. I can tell she loves animals and would want the best for your fur baby. I greatly appreciated her help today. I will definitely come here again.
Maggie was very nice and understanding and Dr Garcia is very nice
We are very well taken care of by a thoughtful and empathetic staff.  Loving treatment!
Love the team over at companion. They’re always friendly and take great care of my pup.

My parents took our golden in for a check up with Dr. Carbajal and it was fantastic. She is so professional and kind during the entire process. My mom came away from the experience really assured that our dog is in great hands while also getting great advice on next steps like a dental. Dr. Carbajal is amazing and her ability to communicate as a vet in both english and spanish adds a tremendous value to anyone looking for pet health in the chicago area.

Maggie was so knowledgeable and  helpful on shots& medicine. Doctor Cheryl  Schoessow and Maggie so loving & sweet with Peach. Doctor Schoessow was teaching  me about how to distinguish the color of the junk from peach eyes if serious or not & how to put drops n properly.
Thank you for everything!
Great vets!

I've been seeing Dr. Cheryl for 10 years! She does a great job of listening to my concerns and going over all my options and always considers the price in pursuing different options. Also a huge shout out to the techs! They are amazingly friendly, professional, and knowledgeable! It can be a 30 - 60 minute drive for me depending on traffic and I still make it out to this vet office because of the customer service and empathy.
Clean, very friendly and efficient service.
My pup enjoys coming here! The staff is always so sweet & communicative.
I have been bringing both my dog and cat here for many years. They have always received excellent care!
Great vet and excellent staff! Our various cats and dogs have always received reliable and compassionate care over the years, and we highly recommend the team here!

Brought my newly adopted dog in for a checkup today and they were very helpful and great with my doggo. We are working through some anxiety and they made the visit comfortable for him and helped give me a good treatment plan. Thank you!!
Super thorough, have been coming here for years, recommend
They’ve taken care of many of my babies, and are always caring and kind!

Excellent care & timely.
Staff is wonderful.
Very sweet to my cat.

So impressed by Companion Animal Hospital! I appreciated the time they took with me and my puppy, and I was impressed by how thorough they were and their dedication to education of the owner. I feel lucky to have found such a positive place to bring my sweet pup!

I had an excellent experience with the doctors at the animal hospital. They were incredibly knowledgeable, compassionate, and patient with both me and my pet. They took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all my questions, and made sure I felt comfortable with the treatment plan.

I have been seeing Dr. Cheryl for many many years. She has taken care of 5 of my own dogs and many of my families as well. She is one of my favorite people and an extraordinary vet. I trust her wholeheartedly!

This is a corporate chain. They're based out of Miami, FL and this explains why there are offices all over Chicago. It's the fast food of vet offices. They care more about profits and volume than pets. In the course of a year, we never saw the same vet twice. They run behind, appointments are meaningless, and they rush in and out. They saw my dog and offered barely adequate care, but every single time screwed up his medications. They also won't refill your pets meds with Costco or any other provider. You have to drive in, get the script, and then physically take it somewhere else. Which is absurd. They wanted constant appointments to write the same scripts. In other words $ is more important than your pet. We gave them a chance with several appointments and the good ratings we saw here but never again. TAKE YOUR PET SOMEWHERE ELSE IF YOU LOVE HIM/HER!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Dr C.  Very caring and knowledgeable.   She understands and always wants to recommend what is best for my dog
Great hospital, staff is amazing. My cats are in good hands here!!!

Pacha has been a patient here for some time now. Pacha is a 7yr old reactive pitbull and the team is very supportive and accommodating to him. He recently had an ear hematoma and the team was very friendly and caring. They are well trained in trauma informed care. I highly recommend this location and their entire team!
Thanks for the review!

Had my dog checked due to facial swelling. They were able to see him last minute same day. That was awesome. Did a full checkup and extremely gentle with him. Gave me all the info and suggested what next steps to take going forward and i price  breakdown beforehand. Great staff, very clean and friendly environment. Price was extremely reasonable. Definitely recommend.
I am so happy to have found Companion Animal Hospital Oak Park! The entire staff is fantastic, and Dr. Cheryl Schoessow is truly wonderful!

Great friendly staff. Been coming for the past three years and they have been nothing but educational, supportive and super great with both my cats. Availabilities are good and will work with you always.
Dr Arenas was so great! I’m so grateful for her kindness and compassion. My kitty was not feeling well but he’s definitely bouncing back today!

A friend of mine gave me her wonderful Shi-poo, who I'm just in love with. This is the vet that she was going to, so I just stayed there and I'm glad I did!!!! They are so professional,  so friendly and they don't rush you out. I had a few question concerning the breed I have and they were awesome!!! If you're looking for a vet....look no further!!!! They are awesome!!!❤❤❤

5 years later it is still 5 stars!!!  The Doctors are amazing and very knowledgeable!  They are patient and understanding. My little Buddy can be very protective of me and they understand that.
We worked out a system that works for everyone!  I still recommend Companion for your veterinary needs!!! They are the best!!!
The vet attendant and vet were great listeners and very compassionate and understanding with my older kitties medical needs and shy personality. Will definitely be coming back!
I’ve been bringing my dogs to Companion for over 12 years and always love how well they take care of the animals! It’s clean, the staff are great and truly care for my baby!
I like how they took her in right away and checked her out

Scheduled my dog for a routine exam & vaccine visit. Came in on time and had to wait for 30 minutes after my scheduled appointment time before I was even brought back, as they apparently are short staffed.

I stated multiple times that I just needed the exam and vaccinations, but the tech still tried to include bloodwork on the estimate. $360 total for an exam and three vaccines. Are you kidding me?

This is egregious pricing and I will never come back. I’m upset that I had to come in the first place but we just moved and all the other vets in the area were booked out weeks, and this now makes sense as to why.

Some of the nicest and most helpful staff ever! I brought my cat in, who’s normally nervous around strangers, and they made her feel so comfortable. They did everything to make me and her comfortable starting at a new vet and answered any and all questions I had. I highly recommend them to anyone who wants great care, detail, and attention towards their animal!
Great location, friendly and prompt service.
I chose this location due to proximity, reviews and affordable health care for my senior pit bull.
Dr. Cheryl is the best.  I completely trust her with my  dog.  Maddie and the rest of the staff are great. Lori the groomer is great
Coming here for 9 years and the experience is  always great. Dr. Cheryll takes the time to explain any concerns and is always sweet and gentle with my fur baby.
the vet and the vet assistants are very friendly (both to people and pets). they made our cat feel comfortable and right at home!
We had a great experience! They were able to get us in for a same day appointment which I appreciated. Very caring and kind staff. Thank you!

Diamond felt very comfortable with the staff. They were gentle and very accommodating
as always.
The absolute Best! Always very attentive to our dogs needs. Highly recommend.
Helpful and informative staff that really seem to care and listen.
Very friendly, informative staff, and works well with the pets
Thanks for the review!
They take amazing care of my cat on a yearly basis!
Always so wonderful to our dog
Friendly Staff, very informative, and always give great service. Our pets are always weary and very curious but they make them feel super comfortable. We have 3 pets and they all come to companion!
My cat gets very anxious during our vet visits, but I appreciate how kind and gentle they are with him! They also answer my questions kindly and make me feel like he’s in good hands.
Very warm and friendly
Me& my dog major been coming here for 10 years now. We love his doctors office. They keep my 3 pound baby feeling like his self.
Everyone is very friendly and professional. And very efficient. Our cats responded well to all the staff!

My Hermynie is 8 yrs and Ms. Willow almost 3 1/2 yrs.  So love the staff and the vets they are still the best.  They are a  really caring and  concerned staff and I would highly recommend for your furry babies. Their knowledge and caring  alone makes it so well worth coming to this site.

I had a great experience at the clinic. They were very nice and welcoming. My pup usually gets anxious at clinics but since this was a new environment for she felt relaxed and comfy! Highly recommend !
Came here for my scooting dog, the doctor still didn’t tell me what was wrong with her but I have to pay $110 for a check up we will never come here again
Dr Cheryl and her staff always give the highest quality of care for our pets. We highly recommend Companion Animal Oak Park for their outstanding Veterinary Services.

They were really nice and patient. They take the time to explain everything to you and treat your pet with the most care. The prices are fair and waiting time is short. They did a great job with my cat who had a swollen face.
The employees are super sweet and handle my pets with a lot of care and affection. Do recommend!

I lost my Chula girl last month, and Animal companion was very sweet helping me through her final day. Although she passed on her own, I knew that would have taken care of her like their own. Today I received an unexpected surprise and a very thoughtful handwritten card from their staff and it filled my heart with such sadness but such gratitude and appreciation. Thank you ACOP, they truly care.

My overalls experience was fantastic. The technician was kind and thorough. And Doctor had a beautiful bedside manner. My puppy received full exam and vaccinations that were age appropriate. Thank you for the great services.
The professionals there are kind, friendly, skilled, & truly make me & my kitty cat Newt feel at home.
I’ve been taking my fur baby here since he was a puppy. My dog loves Dr. Cheryl.
Love coming here. Technicians are very nice & helpful. They always show my dog gentle care & it doesn’t feel like I’m being overcharged like some other hospital’s.
Definitely my go to place with my two cats! The entire staff is so kind, caring and knowledgeable. They make an otherwise scary experience comfortable and calming!
Companion always takes good care of Chibs. They also were very kind to my inquisitive daughter, who wants to be a vet when she grows up, and explained what they were doing.
Great hospital and the staff! Dr. Cheryl is amazing! She takes great care of my pup!
The exam was very thorough and my cat felt very relaxed and well taken care of. All my concerns and questions were answered with care. Looking forward to continuing to come back
They really care about our Fur Babies, masking sure they’re in good health..

Dr. Cheryl and her team were amazing to work with. Sarah was especially patient with my adult cat, which I really appreciated. They always take great care of my cats, and the feedback she provides is always helpful.

We have been taking our dog to Companion Animal Hospital for five years which has included well visits, sick visits, and procedures. We have always had a good experience with the entire staff including front desk, vet techs, and the veterinarians. Would highly recommend.
The vet techs and staff are very nice! They were patient with our dog and understanding. The prices are affordable compared to the other clinic we were taking our dog to.
Kiara was scared coming in and they did awesome making her feel safe. Thank you to the whole team.
Our go-to vet. Always efficient. Service and bedside manner are always excellent!
Staff was great. My Yorkie loves them all. Quality service & care!

We have been taking our dog Finnigan here since he was a puppy and we love it. The staff all know us and treat him like family and the vet visits are always super comprehensive. The workers here ALWAYS go out of their way to explain things clearly and get you whatever you need! I never feel awkward calling to ask about a small concern or with strange questions because I know I will be taken seriously and helped. They are super up front with pricing and do what they can to make the visit the most affordable they can.

Seriously could not recommend this place enough!!
I have found the staff to be very personable and caring. They have been a big help.
Did a phenomenal job taking care of my dog
Companion Animal Hospital takes great care of our cat Huckle. Very nice and caring staff!

The staff at Companion Animal Hospital is great.  The technician and doctor were so friendly to our kitten at her first visit, and the information we received about the next few visits and her treatment plan was thorough and well-presented.  I highly recommend this practice!

We've been coming here since we got our first dog back in 2021, and even throughout multiple moves away from Oak Park we continue to come back! The staff are all incredibly friendly, polite, and helpful and we've always appreciated the professionalism and knowledge that Dr Cheryl provides!

The staff was wonderful with my puppy.
Dr Cheryl was on top of her game. Answered all questions and concerns. Everyone was filled with kindness and purpose. Kick ass experience

We can't say enough good things about Companion Animal Hospital! From the moment we walked in, everyone was so welcoming and truly felt like great people. They literally saved our dog, Kratos, by catching potential kidney issues before they became full-blown stones. They also provided invaluable guidance with his diet, which has made a huge difference. We are so grateful for their exceptional care!

The atmosphere is pleasant, the team is very friendly. The doctor lets you know what it is she going to do and what to expect afterwards. I believe they really do care for the animals. I always want to cry  when it's time to pay. I know my dog is in good hands.. 😊 …
Everyone was friendly, patient & kind!

Companion Oak Park animal hospital has the best, most compassionate staff working there. From the front desk to the techs to the doctors they are truly incredible. I have 4 dogs and I completely trust Companion to take care of them. Highly recommend.

Absolutely incredible Hospital and staff! Dr. Cheryl is brilliant and treats my dog as if it’s her own. ❤️ They offer so many suggestions before adding additional services, to keep the visits affordable. We drive 35 minutes every time we come here because it’s truly a pleasant experience for all of us every time we come, including our fur babies.

We have been extremely happy with our vet at Companion Animal Hospital, and have built a lasting relationship with our preferred vet, Cheryl.  We moved out of the area five years ago, but continue to drive 40 miles each way so we can keep bringing our dog to see her.
We scheduled a visit with Cheryl this week, but when we arrived at 3pm, we were informed that she was not in today.  We would have appreciated a call to give us the option to reschedule.

My parents have taken my childhood dog here, and I’ve now been taking their senior dog here as well. They’re very welcoming and caring to the dogs. They’re willing to work with appointments and payments. They’re amazing.
My friend referred me to this place. They are very kind and attentive and very clean
Dr. Cheryl and the rest of the team here are so kind and patient! They explain everything very thoroughly and don’t make you feel rushed at all. Such a caring team!
Excellent service, great staff I have a great experience i back a gain with my cat thank for your service and patience

Dr. Stricker is amazing- she and her vet tech Sarah were very gentle with our very scared cat. Dr. Stricker handled all our questions and made sure we were all set with new food recommendations when we walked out. Very pleasant experience!
Great service. Gave a thorough exam and explained everything in great detail.
They deliver perfect service... they keep the purpose in mind and comfort intact-- for pets and people.

Dr. Cheryl and the rest of Companion Oak Park Staff has always been great to myself and my animals. Always a great experience. Dr. Cheryl has been taking care of my animals for over 10+ years and my family and I trust her immensely! 100/10 experience always at Companion Oak Park!
Jocelyn is very knowledgeable and dependable.

I would highly recommend this hospital for anyone. they've always taken great care of my 2 dogs. The receptionist, Jocelyn is so nice and welcoming and Dr. Cheryl treats my dogs as if they're her own.
Everyone was very kind and took the time to answer all of my questions

I can't say enough good things about Companion Animal Hospital Oak Park! The staff is incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about every pet that walks through the door. They took amazing care of my pet, making sure they were comfortable and well looked after. The vets take the time to explain everything clearly and answer all questions with patience. The facility is clean and welcoming, and scheduling appointments is always easy. If you're looking for a place that treats your pet like family, this is it! Highly recommend! 🐾💙
Amazing place, 10/10

This is a profit-first, animals-second establishment.
There are good people working at Companion, but they lack decision making authority.
We used to be customers. The day we were turned away with a half-alive kitten due to “lack of available appointments” was our last. And yes - the entire waiting room was aghast.
Better that you find a locally owned vet.

I would recommend Companion to anyone looking for a staff that truly cares about their patients. They took care of my dog Tiny Tim for the last 7 years of his life and will continue to be our primary vet for all of our other dogs and cats. Dr. Cheryl is extremely caring and amazing at her job. When my dog was diagnosed with a terminal heart condition, she steered me towards an amazing specialist and he ended up living 3 years after his initial diagnosis. She also took great care of him for his annual visits and check ups. All of the vet techs are wonderful and create a very welcoming environment for anxious pets and owners. My pup exclusively got haircuts with Lori and I would reccomend her to anyone that wants their dogs to be in a safe and well maintained grooming environment. The front desk staff, especially Jocelyn, has always been so kind to me and my fur babies. I can’t thank this team enough. If you are in need of a vet office who you want to trust will look after your pet as if they were their own, this is it!

Laurie is the absolute best for grooming. Always does a great job and our pup is so much less stressed than the big-time groomers with a zillion dogs in at the same time. Thank you for always taking such great care of her!

As always the service here is great.  Waited longer than usual on yesterday.  Also, is there a reason that the rabies vaccination has to be part of the wellness exam?  Ended up costing me over $400.00.  I thought I was only coming for the rabies vac.
well managed visit

We were looking for a new vet closer to home, that took appointments, for basic checkups and concerns. For any major concerns we have a friend we use but she is all the way in Elmhurst. We brought our new rescue pup here because of some …
The staff was very thorough, gentle and kind in caring for our cat. It helped so much that we could be in the exam room with  her this year.
Dr. Sheryl is a wonderful and caring veterinarian who is always available for explanations. Also staff from her clinic wonderful people and very supportive.
I have been taking my dog, Louie, to this vet since I first got him 5 years ago! The staff is friendly and helpful! The vets are very kind and professional!
The doctor and her medical staff have lots of patience with my dog, which can be very handful with his anxiety.

The wait time is ridiculous at Companion Animal Hospital — waited over an hour for our appointment time after showing up 10 minutes early too. But then they have a 10 minute grace period for showing up to the appointment on time. Doesn’t make sense.
Staff is very polite, handled my dogs ashes carefully. Rip Kiro
